questionStatus: Original AI-assisted draft; no publisher text or questions reproduced; no human editorial review yet
levelStatus: Editorial estimates for practice organisation, not verified official test-item levels
coverage: 216 questions across five pathways: N5 and N4 each have 60 checkpoint items and 30 distinct timed-sample items; N3, N2 and N1 retain six checkpoint and six sample items each. No internal listening exam, sentence-order task or full-length mock test.
selection: Two items per checkpoint, six per timed sample with two per written section. Prefer unseen then least-seen items in saved history; persist selected IDs. Historical question IDs and answer positions are preserved. Completion does not require full bank coverage.
authoring: scripts/author-n5-bank.py and scripts/author-n4-bank.py preserve historical items and compile original answer-first drafts. content/jlpt/bank-sizes.json declares expected sizes. AI-assisted answer/context review; no native-editor approval or psychometric calibration.
sourceMethod: Publisher catalogues establish series/level availability and provide external study access. Shiori focus lists, gates and assignments are original editorial organisation, not a publisher chapter-by-chapter mapping. Learners record their own edition and pages.
